ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ISBLANK(Posting_URL__c), NOT(REGEX(Source_Record_Key__c, "^(gmail:[0-9a-f]{1,64}|(sheet|email):[0-9a-f]{64})$")), OR( NOT(BEGINS(Posting_URL__c, "https://")), NOT(REGEX(Source_Record_Key__c, "^(linkedin:[0-9]+|greenhouse:[a-z0-9_-]+:[0-9]+|url:[0-9a-f]{64})$")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Provide a valid source key for the email or HTTPS posting.
